description: Korean 노란우산공제 (small business mutual aid) income deduction (조특법 제86조의3): payments deducted from business income up to 6M (income ≤ 40M KRW), 5M (≤ 60M), 4M (≤ 100M) or 2M (above); small-company CEOs only with salary ≤ 80M, against earned income. Returns the limit, deduction and tax saved including local tax at progressive rates. Annual payment cap 18M from July 2026.

income.description: Business income (revenue − expenses, excluding real-estate rental); for ceo the total salary (KRW)

kind.description: business = sole proprietor; ceo = small-company representative

otherDeductions.description: Other income deductions such as personal deductions (default 1.5M) (KRW)
